title: [RMVXA]Character Resources Recolored with Dark Skin Tones

posts.author: MiguelRPG
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I found a collection of RPG Maker VX Ace sprites recolored for dark skin tones that was on a blog which is now offline. I believe this is a good place to maintain access to these resources that can help with the diversity of projects.
This initiative came from a request by the user
@guts_cearense
in the post
Dark-skin recolor for RMVXA RTP characters
. The sprites have multiple versions of skin tone, allowing for greater variety in character creation.
Spoiler:

More characters in zip
Terms:
The original terms of use are:"These sprites are free to use, edit, and redistribute. Credit is not necessary but it is appreciated, also don’t claim these as your own! Credit me under the name SLEEP and/or the url of this blog. These can be used commercially."
Credits:
RPG Maker Developer (Komodo)
Editor: SLEEP
I have no credit or rights over this material, please observe the terms of use by the authors of Komodo (I am not sure who holds the rights to RMVX Ace)
Here are the recolored resources:

and
page 2
I hope these resources are useful and help enrich your projects. Keeping assets like these available is essential to promoting diversity and creativity in our games.
